title: Lazy XLS shared-string indexing: sizing, corpus census and frozen design
disposition: design only; no file under crates/ was modified
worktree: /home/zhuhe/code/litchi-worktrees/0608 (detached from the shared checkout; the shared repository was neither built in nor modified)

host.pinning: setarch x86_64 -R (ASLR off), taskset -c 28, single-threaded, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
host.quiescence: NOT established; eight measurement agents shared this host and the load average ran between 6.1 and 10.8 on 32 cores across the capture window. Both floors below are measured, not assumed.

legs.name: nostore
legs.what: MEASUREMENT SCAFFOLD, not a candidate: walks every shared string exactly as production does, reserves nothing and records nothing. Prices the storage alone.

legs.name: nowalk
legs.what: MEASUREMENT SCAFFOLD, not a candidate: builds the segments and runs every SST header check, then skips the per-string walk entirely. Prices the ceiling of full deferral at open.

legs.name: aa / bb
legs.what: byte-for-byte copies of the base binary, run through the identical pipeline to measure the floor in the same window

census_corpus: every .xls and .xlt file under test-data, 126 of them, listed in fixtures.txt

harness_scope.mode: owned-readat and file-source; both wrap staged bytes or a staged immutable file, so no cold or physical I/O is measured
harness_scope.operations: open, list, one-cell; xls_source_attribution has no full-text and no all-cells selector, which is change 0587's standing XLS measurement blocker
harness_scope.one_cell_target: row 1, column 0 of the worksheet index given per fixture (1, 1 and 0 respectively)
